structure_checkpoints: Landscape 1536x1024. A deliberately PARTIAL roof-detail architectural plate of Puren Temple main hall: draw exactly the ornate side GABLE (shanhua) under the yellow glazed hip-and-gable roof, the green/red glazed scrollwork gable panels, side roof slope, eave and visible blue-green bracket/beam zone immediately below. Follow the actual photo angle and its crop. It is a selected upper side elevation detail, NOT the whole seven-bay front hall. Do not invent lower walls, columns, steps or full facade. Complete visible roof edges with breathing room, remove leaves, sky and branches; no words.
material_observations: 黄琉璃瓦和黄边山花，山花内绿、红、浅色装饰，檐下蓝绿斗栱及梁枋；保留主殿实有黄瓦，不套金色滤镜。

site_recommendation.yearNote: 溥仁寺创建于1713年，所绘为现存清代主殿屋顶山花及檐下局部；该纪年对应寺院营建，图版不表现完整殿体。
site_recommendation.lede: 黄琉璃瓦下，山花的绿红纹饰被层层檐线围住。这幅局部图版把溥仁寺主殿的侧面装饰单独展开，呈现清代琉璃与彩画的细节。
facts: 溥仁寺创建于清康熙五十二年（1713），列入第五批国保。
主殿为七间单檐歇山顶建筑，覆黄色琉璃瓦。
图版选择山花及侧面檐下局部，不补画照片未展示的完整立面。
